en.question: <<19182>>'s text prevents it from being used as Xyz Material while it itself has material. Can I Special Summon <<11654>> by first detaching the only material that <<19182>> has, then using it as Xyz Material for <<11654>>'s Summon?
en.title: Can I Xyz Summon <<11654>> using a <<19182>> with 1 material?
